The sign is exactly 1-V_r(x)V_r(y) for 0<x,y<1; monotonicity gives the unique sharp tau_r and root witness, and the decreasing limit. Tree telescoping converges absolutely by summability of rho^(a+b), establishing the identity without extrapolation from finite tests. value.rationale: The 2026 source explicitly seeks structural classifications for factorizable rational potentials over the coprime tree. The theorem provides a sharp entire-integer-family rigidity classification, not an arbitrary isolated experiment. Its exact positivity boundary distinguishes nonnegative and sign-changing local decompositions even though the global coprime sum remains positive, with the first transition at inverse golden ratio and thresholds approaching one half. This constrains further positive-kernel constructions in the proposed rational-potential program; it does not claim a general classification of all potentials.
